summary: Diginex Limited furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) updating shareholders ahead of its October 8, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting on the acquisition of 100% of Resulticks Global Companies Pte. Limited under an Amended and Restated Sale and Purchase Agreement dated August 14, 2026; record date August 14, 2026. The disclosure details Resulticks' existing debt: a US$40.0 million Ascertis term facility with roughly US$31.8 million outstanding maturing by December 3, 2029, secured by IP, share pledges and founder guarantees, where the takeover triggers a change of control requiring a lender no-objection certificate as a condition precedent; and roughly US$21.0 million of Anicut facilities to be refinanced pre-closing. Watch lender consent, guarantee substitution and financing overhang risk.
